summary.zh-CN: 残差连接让输入同时走两条路径：一条经过[[term:convolution|卷积]]、[[term:attention-mechanism|注意力]]或[[term:position-wise-ffn|前馈网络]]等主变换，另一条作为 shortcut 直接绕过主变换；两路最后逐元素相加。
summary.en-US: A residual connection sends the input along two paths: one applies a main transformation such as [[term:convolution|convolution]], [[term:attention-mechanism|attention]], or [[term:position-wise-ffn|feed-forward processing]], while the other shortcut bypasses the main transformation. The two paths are then added element by element.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 输出等于主支路变换结果加上原输入，使原信息和梯度都拥有一条较直接的通路。
coreConclusion.en-US: The output adds the main-path transformation to the original input, giving both information and gradients a more direct route.
